questions.prompt: Explain Goroutines in Go to an engineer who must use it tomorrow. Explain the mental model, vocabulary, and one important limit.

answer.modelAnswer:

In a production system, every goroutine needs a clear owner and exit path. Bound fan-out, pass context cancellation, inspect goroutine counts and profiles, and use the race detector; replace goroutines with a queue or worker service when work must survive process failure.
